g.text: CHX10-Cre; Ddx41 fl/fl vs. littermate control, n = 3 per genotype. Each dot is one marker gene; the diamond is the panel median. The dashed line is the median

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: shift of all genes with baseMean >= 5,000, i.e. what a highly expressed gene gains from library scaling alone. Rods clear that line by only 0.15 log2 units

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: (about 11%), so the photoreceptor gene sets that score as enriched are rising in share as cones and inner neurons are lost, not being induced.
